cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Expand Your Jurisdiction
cards.instruction: Use every new problem as a reason to expand what you are entitled to control.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Your deliveries keep arriving during meetings. I need to approve the van schedule.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You book the rooms. I'll send you our arrival times.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Send the routes too. I'll approve those so the times hold.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The council keeps closing the access road. We can't schedule around that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Give them my number. Road closures will need to fit my room bookings.
